Definition: Rogelim, a place East of the Jordan
BiblicalUsage: The name is Rogelim, a place East of the Jordan. You find the name in 2 Samuel 17:27, "…to Mahanaim, that Shobi the son of Nahash…", and again in 2 Samuel 19:31.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Rogelim matters because God marks the places of his story, one by one. I hold that no name in Scripture is there by accident.
